name: virtualization_mcp
description: VirtualBox & Hyper-V VM management, Docker sandbox execution, Windows Sandbox bringup, snapshots, networking, storage, and fleet install testing via FastMCP 3.4
long_description: Virtualization MCP is a production-ready FastMCP 3.4 server providing comprehensive VM management (VirtualBox + Hyper-V), Docker sandbox environments (ephemeral and stateful), Windows Sandbox bringup, snapshot management, networking, storage, system diagnostics, ISO download pipeline, and fleet app install testing. 8 portmanteau tools with 60+ operations.

vbox_install_path.title: VirtualBox Installation Directory
vbox_install_path.description: Directory where VirtualBox is installed (e.g., C:\Program Files\Oracle\VirtualBox)

vbox_user_home.title: VirtualBox User Home
vbox_user_home.description: Directory where VirtualBox stores VM files and settings

tools.name: vm_management
tools.description: Portmanteau: list, create, start, stop, delete, clone, reset, pause, resume, info

tools.name: network_management
tools.description: Portmanteau: list/create/remove host-only networks, list adapters, configure adapter

tools.name: snapshot_management
tools.description: Portmanteau: list, create, restore, delete snapshots

tools.name: system_management
tools.description: Portmanteau: host info, VBox version, OS types, metrics, screenshot

tools.name: sandbox_management
tools.description: Portmanteau: ephemeral code exec, stateful sessions, file I/O

tools.name: hyperv_management
tools.description: Portmanteau: list, get, start, stop Hyper-V VMs

tools.name: proxmox_management
tools.description: Portmanteau: Proxmox VE VMs, snapshots, node status via REST
